system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have nothing equipped to either of your [Hand Slots]. When you use a skill with a [Hate] cost of 3 or higher, reduce the [Hate] cost of that skill by -1 (minimum 0).

(SR2): You gain a +2 bonus to [Accuracy].

A combat style that does not carry weapons or shields, and concentrates on praying without hands. It becomes difficult for the other party to turn hostile toward you.
